summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a 6-K announcing pricing of USD 700 million 5.750% Notes due 2036, with proceeds of USD 690.93 million after underwriting discounts. Proceeds will fund purchase of its outstanding 2.032% Senior Notes due 2030 via a tender offer plus fees, with the remainder for general corporate purposes. The offering is scheduled to close September 11, 2026, subject to customary conditions; BofA, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho and SMBC Nikko are named. This is a debt refinancing liability-management exercise; watch tender acceptance and any residual 2030 notes outstanding.
